name: Suganthan's GSC MCP
summary: Suganthan's GSC MCP is a free open source Node.js server by Suganthan Mohanadasan that runs on your own machine for Claude Desktop and Claude Code.
signIn: Your own Google Cloud OAuth client (Desktop app client secrets JSON, browser sign-in) or a service account JSON key added to the Search Console property. The setup wizard still needs your own OAuth client JSON; the README says a built in Google sign in ships once Google verifies a shared client.
tools: 29 tools, stated in the README ('All 29 tools') and the setup guide on suganthan.com.
free: Yes. The README says 'Free and open source' and the setup guide lists the server as free with no ongoing cost.
writeActions: Can submit URLs to Google's Indexing API (single or batch up to 200 a day) and submit sitemaps. generate_report saves a report to disk. The setup wizard defaults to a read only scope; a manual config with no GSC_SCOPES gets full access.
dataStorage: Runs on your machine. Tokens are cached locally at ~/.gsc-mcp/. The README says data goes directly between your machine and Google and the developer operates no servers. image_page_audit also fetches pages from your own site.
history: Google's 16 months (the README says genai_conversation_queries classifies sixteen months of queries)
setup: Create a Google Cloud project, enable the Search Console API, create an OAuth Desktop client and download the JSON, then run npx -y suganthan-gsc-mcp setup, which signs in and writes the Claude Desktop and Claude Code config. Alternatives are a .mcpb bundle for Claude Desktop or editing the JSON config by hand. Node.js is needed for npx. Indexing tools also need the Web Search Indexing API enabled and owner access.
pickIf: You want image search tools, including an on-page image audit.
You want a tool that re-queries Search Console to double-check a number.
You want a one-click bundle for Claude Desktop.
